title: Lovely
text: Lovely. Love these blankets, the colors really pop in my living room. If your dog is allowed on the couch, his nails will pluck the blanket because it is a knit weave. I will just have to replace periodically and get different colors.

product_metadata.title: Home Soft Things Yellow Throw Blanket Knitted Tweed Throw 50'' x 60'', Lemon Curry, Super Soft Cozy Warm Comfortable Breathable Throw for Living Room Chair Couch Bed Sofa Bedroom Home Décor
features: CLASSIC POPULAR, TOP SELLING STYLE! Chic, beautiful woven Knitted Tweed design features diamond patterns made of super soft microfiber polyester for a plush, textured look and feel. The design is finished off with adorable knotted braid tassels along each side of the widths.

YEAR ROUND USE! This knitted tweed throw is irresistibly soft and has versatile design that can be used all YEAR ROUND. It is light weight making it great for summer and easy transportation between rooms. Yet, it is still hardy and cozy enough to layer during chilly winter months.

FABULOUS GIFTS CREATE PRICELESS SMILES! Send Your Loved Ones The Gift Of Comfort. Throw comes artfully wrapped in a ribbon tied in bow and includes a product card for effortless giving. Include a personalized message upon request.

TREAT YOUR THROW TO A LITTLE TLC: Machine Wash, Separately, Cold Water, Delicate Cycle. Tumble Dry on Lowest Heat Setting. With proper Care, your throw gets softer and softer after each wash without risk of losing color. All Serenta products are heat treated to lock in color for ultimate fade resistance and are built to last a lifetime.
THROW BLANKETS AVAILABLE IN 2 SIZES FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE: Standard - 50" x 60" Jumbo / 60" x 80" 100% Microfiber Polyester
